rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The two seas symbolize bodily, material nature, bitter and dense, and immaterial spirit, sweet and subtle.
rows.anchor: بحر الهيولى الجسمانية الذي هو الملح الأجاج وبحر الروح المجرد الذي هو العذاب الفرات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They meet in the human being, where the animal soul serves as an intermediate between spirit and body.
rows.anchor: هو النفس الحيوانية التي ليست في صفاء الأرواح المجردة ولطافتها ولا في كدورة الأجساد الهيولانية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Neither side exceeds its limit or dominates the other: spirit does not immaterialize the body, nor does body make spirit material.
rows.anchor: لا يتجاوز حدهما حده فيغلب على الآخر بخاصيته فلا الروح يجرد البدن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their union yields pearls of universal sciences, meaning truths and gnoses, and coral of particular beneficial sciences such as ethics and revealed law.
rows.anchor: لؤلؤ العلوم الكلية ومرجان العلوم الجزئية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The ships signify forms of the sacred law and stations of the spiritual path, carrying seekers across the sea toward their destination.
rows.anchor: أوضاع الشريعة ومقامات الطريقة التي يركبها السالكون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The ships’ comparison to landmarks signals that the sacred law and religion’s signs are famous and well known.
rows.anchor: تشبيهها بالأعلام إشارة إلى شهرتها وكونه معروفة كما تسمى شعائر الله ومعالم الدين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The raised vessels’ sails are longings and intentions, propelled toward the upper realm by divine inspirations; the law and path carry their riders to perfection in annihilation in God.
rows.anchor: الأشواق والإرادات التي تجري عند ارتفاعها وتعلقها بالعالم العلوي بقوة رياح النفحات الإلهية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: All aboard the sailing vessels reach God through annihilation in Him.
rows.anchor: كل من على الجواري السائرة واصل إلى الحق بالفناء فيه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, every particular being on the body’s earth—spirit, intellect, heart, soul, their stations and ranks—vanishes on reaching the goal.
rows.anchor: كل من على أرض الجسد من الأعيان المفصلة كالروح والعقل والقلب والنفس ومنازلها ومقاماتها ومراتبها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The face that remains after creation’s passing is God’s essence together with all His attributes.
rows.anchor: أي: ذاته مع جميع صفاته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Divine majesty is greatness and exaltation: God veils Himself with luminous and dark veils and manifests through dominion and overpowering.
rows.anchor: العظمة والعلو بالاحتجاب بالحجب النورانية والظلمانية والظهور بصفة القهر والسلطنة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Divine generosity is nearness through manifestations of the attributes, and the essence’s appearance through gentleness and mercy.
rows.anchor: بالقرب والدنو في صور تجليات الصفات وعند ظهورالذات بصفة اللطف والرحمة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Excellence in action means worship performed with presence; its recompense is excellence in reward through perfection and arrival at the two gardens.
rows.anchor: في العمل وهو العبادة مع الحضور

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “Behind them” can mean in a nearby place beyond them; it does not mean in front of them relative to their occupants.
rows.anchor: من ورائهما من مكان قريب منهما كما تقول:

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The phrase can alternatively mean “other than them,” as in the cited wording about what people worship besides God.
rows.anchor: بل بمعنى بعدهما أو من غيرهما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: These gardens belong to the foremost and brought-near: the garden of spirit and the garden of the essence in the unity of witnessing the essence, beyond witnessing in the station of spirit.
rows.anchor: جنة الروح وجنة الذات في عين الجمع عند الشهود الذاتي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The two gardens are at the utmost degree of joy, beauty, and freshness.
rows.anchor: في غاية البهجة والحسن والنضارة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The two springs are knowledge of the unity of essence and of attributes: knowledge of annihilation and of direct witnessing.
rows.anchor: علم توحيد الذات وتوحيد الصفات أعني علم الفناء وعلم المشاهدة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: These two knowledges flow in the gardens, but their source is the two gardens just described; they spring from them and flow into those gardens.
rows.anchor: بل العلمان المذكوران الجاريان في الجنتين المذكورتين منبعهما من هاتين الجنتين ينبعان منهما ويجريان إلى تينك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their resurrection is their being raised from the resting places of their bodies.
rows.anchor: بإقامتهم عن مراقد الأبدان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their deeds are disclosed because their forms have been imprinted on the tablets of their souls.
rows.anchor: لانتقاش صور أعمالهم في ألواح نفوسهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God has enumerated the deeds by recording them in the four books mentioned.
rows.anchor: بإثباته في الكتب الأربعة المذكورة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They forgot their deeds because sensual pleasures and bodily preoccupations distracted and absorbed them.
rows.anchor: لذهولهم عنه باشتغالهم باللذات الحسية وانهماكهم في الشواغل البدنية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God is present with everything and watches over it.
rows.anchor: حاضر معه رقيب

words: ما يكون من نجوى ثلاثة إلا هو رابعهم
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God is not a fourth by number or proximity: their individuations and contingent quiddities distinguish and veil them, while His necessary being sustains them and appears in their loci.
rows.anchor: لا بالعدد والمقارنة بل بامتيازهم عنه بتعيناتهم واحتجابهم عنه بماهياتهم وأنياتهم وافتراقهم منه بالإمكان اللازم لماهياتهم

words: ما يكون من نجوى ثلاثة إلا هو رابعهم
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Viewed in reality, God is their very identity; the source adds that without such distinctions, wisdom would cease.
rows.anchor: قيل: لولا الاعتبارات لارتفعت الحكمة

words: ما يكون من نجوى ثلاثة إلا هو رابعهم
rows.speaker: أمير المؤمنين عليه السلام
rows.claim: The saying attributed to the Commander of the Faithful is that knowledge is a point which the ignorant multiplied.
rows.anchor: أمير المؤمنين عليه السلام: " العلم نقطة كثرها الجاهلون "

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Because the Messenger is realized through God, his commands and prohibitions are God’s; Qashani cites 53:3–4 as support.
rows.anchor: لأنه متحقق بالله فكل ما أمر به فهو أمر الله وما نهى عنه نهي الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The poor emigrants are those who leave and detach themselves from the station of the lower soul.
rows.anchor: التاركين المجردين المهاجرين عن مقام النفس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God expelled them: if they had left by their own agency, they would remain veiled by ego and by pride in their renunciation.
rows.anchor: لو خرجوا بنفوسهم لاحتجبوا بها وبرؤية الترك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their homes and property signify the lower soul’s stations, familiar attachments, attributes, and known things.
rows.anchor: أي: صفات نفوسهم ومعلوماتهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The bounty they seek consists of sciences and ethical virtues.
rows.anchor: من العلوم والفضائل الخلقية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God’s good pleasure here means lofty spiritual states and gifts from the lights of attribute manifestations.
rows.anchor: من الأحوال والمواهب السنية من أنوار تجليات الصفات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They support God and His Messenger by offering their souls, through the strength of certainty.
rows.anchor: ببذل النفوس لقوة اليقين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They are true in certain faith because their actions verify their claim; certainty shows itself in the limbs, whose movements follow its knowledge.
rows.anchor: علامة وجدان اليقين ظهور أثره على الجوارح بحيث لا تمكن حركاتها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The home and faith signify the original abode of primordial nature and the first covenant, the locus of faith; the lower soul is exile.
rows.anchor: المقر الأصلي الذي هو الفطرة الأولى والعهد الأول

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “Before them” means before the emigrants’ migration from the exile of the soul to this original home, which precedes their former dwellings; Qashani cites the saying, “Love of homeland is part of faith.”
rows.anchor: من قبل هجرة المهاجرين من دار الغربة التي هي النفس إليها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: These residents retained primordial purity without the soul’s veil, unlike the first emigrants, who became clouded and later regained purity through spiritual wayfaring.
rows.anchor: فهم الذين لم يسقطوا عن الفطرة ولم يحتجبوا بحجاب النفس في النشأة وبقوا على صفائها بخلاف الأولين الذين تكدروا وتغيروا ثم رجعوا إلى الصفاء بالسير والسلوك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They love the emigrants because of shared purity, original affinity, true kinship, and recollection of the prior covenant through religious agreement and brotherhood.
rows.anchor: لوجود الجنسية في الصفاء وتحقق المناسبة الأصلية والقرابة الحقيقية بالوفاء وتذكر العهد السابق بالموافقة في الدين والإخاء

words: وَلَا يَجِدُونَ فِى صُدُورِهِمْ حَاجَةًۭ مِّمَّآ أُوتُوا۟
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They feel no envy over the emigrants’ allotments because their hearts are safe from the soul’s afflictions and greed, detached from worldly shares, and certain of their own apportionment.
rows.anchor: لسلامة قلوبهم عن آفات النفوس وطهارتها عن دواعي الحرص وتنزهها عن محبة الحظوظ وتيقنها بالاقسام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They prefer others through detachment, turning toward the holy presence, innate virtue, and deep love for true brothers and companions on the path.
rows.anchor: لتجردهم وتوجههم إلى جناب القدس وترفهم عن مواد الرجس وكون الفضيلة لهم أمرا ذاتيا باقتضاء الفطرة وفرط محبة الإخوان بالحقيقة والأعوان في الطريقة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Giving others precedence despite hardship reflects chivalry, perfect manliness, strong unity, restraint from ego’s share, and fear of returning to partial desires after tasting universal ones.
rows.anchor: فتقديمهم أصحابهم على أنفسهم لمكان الفتوة وكمال المروءة ولقوة التوحيد والاحتراز عن حظ النفس وخوف الرجوع إلى المطالب الجزئية بعد وجدان الذوق من المطالب الكلية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Greed is intrinsic to the lower soul, which inclines downward and loves particular gains; it ends only with the soul, and deliverance from its evils comes through God’s protection.
rows.anchor: والشح من غرائزها المعجونة في طينتها لملازمتها الجهة السفلية ومحبتها الحظوظ الجزئية فلا ينتفي منها إلا عند انتفائها ولكن المعصوم من تلك الآفات والشرور من عصمه الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The successful attain the perfections of the heart.
rows.anchor: فأولئك هم المفلحون } بالكمالات القلبية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People are presented before God with the inward forms of their deeds and actions.
rows.anchor: على الله بما في أنفسكم من هيئات الأعمال وصورالأفعال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The book is the bodily tablet bearing the forms of one’s deeds; receiving it in the right hand means on the stronger, divine side, namely the intellect.
rows.anchor: أي: جانبه الأقوى الإلهي الذي هو العقل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The recipient rejoices and wants to inspect the book’s beautiful dispositions and signs of felicity.
rows.anchor: فيفرح به ويحب الاطلاع على أحواله من الهيئات الحسنة وآثار السعادة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: His invitation to read the book expresses joy at seeing its beautiful dispositions and signs of felicity.
rows.anchor: هاؤهم اقرؤوا كتابيه * إني ظننت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “I thought” means “I was certain,” because he believed in resurrection, gathering, accounting, and recompense.
rows.anchor: لإيماني بالبعث والنشور والحساب والجزاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: His pleasing life is true, everlasting, and eternal life.
rows.anchor: أي: حياة حقيقية أبدية سرمدية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The garden is one of the gardens of the heart and spirit.
rows.anchor: من جنان القلب والروح

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Its elevated fruits are the heart and spirit’s perceptions of meanings and realities, which they reach whenever they wish.
rows.anchor: من مدركات القلب والروح من المعاني والحقائق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The seven heavens are the seven levels of the unseen, layered one above another.
rows.anchor: من مراتب الغيوب السبعة المذكورة ذات طباق بعضها فوق بعض

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The moon is the heart, whose light surpasses that of the soul and the stars of the faculties.
rows.anchor: زائدا نوره على نور النفس ونجوم القوى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sun is the spirit, a lamp with brilliant light.
rows.anchor: نجوم القوى { وجعل } شمس الروح { سراجا } باهرا نوره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God’s growing people from the earth means their emergence from the earth of the body.
rows.anchor: من أرض البدن { نباتا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Returning to earth means inclining toward it, taking on its pleasures and desires, and acquiring bodily dispositions and material veils.
rows.anchor: بميلكم إليها وتلبسكم بشهواتها ولذاتها وبهيئات نفوسكم الجسمانية وغواشيكم الهيولانية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Being brought forth is resurrection from that earth at the station of the heart through voluntary death.
rows.anchor: بالبعث منه في مقام القلب عند الموت الإرادي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The earth spread as a carpet lets people travel the broad paths of the senses.
rows.anchor: فجاجا } خروقا واسعة أو من جهتها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, the earth is a route toward the heaven of spirit and unity, along paths of spiritual perfection.
rows.anchor: أو من جهتها سبل سماء الروح إلى التوحيد

rows.speaker: أمير المؤمنين عليه السلام
rows.claim: The Commander of the Faithful says he knows the paths of heaven better than the paths of earth.
rows.anchor: عليه السلام: " سلوني عن طرق السماء فإني أعلم بها من طرق الأرض "

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: These heavenly paths are routes to perfection through stations and states such as renunciation, worship, reliance, and contentment; hence the Prophet’s ascension was bodily.
rows.anchor: أراد الطرق الموصلة إلى الكمال من المقامات والأحوال كالزهد والعبادة والتوكل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The one wrapped up is clothed in the veils and coverings of the body.
rows.anchor: المتلفف في غواشي البدن وملابسه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Rise from heedlessness, travel God’s path through the wilderness of the lower soul and the heart’s stages, and journey to God.
rows.anchor: سالكا مسالك بيداء النفس ومراحل مفازة القلب إلى الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The small exception allows necessary rest, food, drink, and bodily needs; together these occupy half the time spent in the natural station, a quarter of the full day each.
rows.anchor: بحكم الضرورة للاستراحة والأكل والشرب ومصالح البدن ومهماته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: For the strong, reduce the night until one third remains: one sixth for rest and one sixth for livelihood’s necessities.
rows.anchor: إن كنت من الأقوياء حتى يبقى الثلث فيكون السدس للاستراحة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: For the weak, increase it to two thirds, leaving one third each for rest, necessities, and devotion to God and the spiritual path.
rows.anchor: إن كنت من الضعفاء حتى يصير إلى الثلثين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Reciting the Quran distinctly means bringing forth, through purification, the meanings and realities gathered in primordial nature and hidden in one’s potential.
rows.anchor: فصل ما في فطرتك من المعاني والحقائق مجموعة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The one cloaked is wrapped in the body’s covering and veiled by its form.
rows.anchor: المتلبس بدثار البدن، المحتجب بصورته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Rise from reliance on natural occupations and awaken from heedlessness.
rows.anchor: عن ما ركنت إليه وتلبست به من أشغال الطبيعة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Warn your own self and faculties, and everyone beyond you, of the great day’s punishment.
rows.anchor: نفسك وقواك وجميع من عداك عذاب يوم عظيم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If anything is magnified, reserve all magnification for the Lord.
rows.anchor: إن كنت تكبر شيئا وتعظم قدره فخصص ربك بالتعظيم والتكبير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Witnessing God’s grandeur makes everything besides Him small in the heart and insignificant to the eye.
rows.anchor: لا يعظم في عينك غيره ويصغر في قلبك كل ما سواه بمشاهدة كبريائه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Purify the outward first, before cleansing the inward of bad character, actions, habits, and material impurity that leads to torment.
rows.anchor: ظاهرك طهره أولا قبل تطهير باطنك عن مدانس الأخلاق وقبائح الأفعال ومذام العادات ورجز الهيولى المؤدي إلى العذاب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abandonment means stripping the inner self of material attachments, bodily dispositions, and dark, material veils.
rows.anchor: جرد باطنك عن اللواحق المادية والهيئات الجسمانية الغاسقة والغواشي الظلمانية الهيولانية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Do not give money after detachment in order to obtain abundant recompense; that makes the gift a veil of blessing from its giver and reflects narrow aspiration.
rows.anchor: فإن ذلك احتجاب بالنعمة عن المنعم وقصور همة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Whatever you do should be solely for God, patiently upholding virtue for His sake and no other reward.
rows.anchor: بل خالصا لوجه الله افعل ما تفعل صابرا على الفضيلة له لا لشيء آخر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Each soul is held by what it earned because the forms of its deeds and effects cling to it and cannot be separated from it.
rows.anchor: عند الله لا فكاك لها لاستيلاء هيئات أعمالها وآثار أفعالها عليها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The blessed people of the right are freed from this pledge because they shed bodily dispositions and reach the station of primordial nature.
rows.anchor: من السعداء الذين تجردوا عن الهيئات الجسدانية وخلصوا إلى مقام الفطرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their gardens are gardens of the divine attributes and acts.
rows.anchor: في جنات } من جنات الصفات والأفعال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those in the gardens ask about the criminals to learn their condition and what caused their punishment and continued stay in the hell of nature.
rows.anchor: يسأل بعضهم بعضا عن حال المجرمين لاطلاعهم عليها وما أوجب تعذيبهم وبقاءهم في سقر الطبيعة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The question they put to the criminals is, “What brought you into Saqar?”
rows.anchor: عن حالهم بقولنا: { ما سلككم في سقر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “No indeed” rebukes the haste described in the preceding passage.
rows.anchor: كلا } ردع له عن العجلة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The addressee shares with other people the human condition and natural tendency of the restless soul to love immediate life.
rows.anchor: سواء حالك وحالهم بحكم البشرية ومقتضى الطبيعة والنفس الطياشة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Radiant faces are illumined by sacred light, connected with the world of light and everlasting bliss, and adorned by their gnoses.
rows.anchor: للتنور بنور القدس والاتصال بعالم النور والسرور والنعيم الدائم متبجحة بزينة معارفها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They rejoice in their own spiritual essence and are linked to the realms of dominion and divine power.
rows.anchor: مبتهجة ببهجة ذاوتها منخرطة في سلك الملكوت والجبروت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They may be oriented solely toward the presence of the Essence, awaiting complete mercy in the station of the attribute-lights.
rows.anchor: إلى حضرة الذات خاصة متوجهة متوقعة للرحمة التامة في مقام أنوار الصفات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, they shine by His light toward His face alone, witnessing Him and turning from everything else.
rows.anchor: ناظرة مشاهدة إياه لا تلتفت إلى ما سواه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They may witness the beauty of His essence and the splendors of His face, or contemplate His attributes without attending to anything else.
rows.anchor: مشاهدة لجمال ذاته وسبحات وجهه أو مطالعة لحسن صفاته لا تشتغل بغيره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Gloomy faces reflect grim dispositions, the darkness of hellfire, the ugliness of its horrors, and the kinds of torment and loss.
rows.anchor: كالحة لجهامة هيئاتها وظلمة ما بها من الجحيم والنيران وسماجة ما تراه مما هناك من الأهوال وأنواع العذاب والخسران

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They expect a calamity that breaks the spine through its severity, disastrous condition, and evil consequence.
rows.anchor: داهية تفصل فقار الظهر لشدتها وسوء حالها ووبالها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet was under his Lord’s nurturing; when his self manifested, it veiled him from the light of truth, so he acted from himself rather than through God.
rows.anchor: فكلما ظهرت نفسه بصفة حجبت عنه نور الحق حتى تحرك بنفسه لا بالله

rows.speaker: النبي
rows.claim: Qashani cites the Prophet’s saying, “My Lord disciplined me and perfected my discipline,” to frame the rebuke as divine education.
rows.anchor: كان صلى الله عليه وسلم في حجر تربية ربه لكونه حبيبا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Adoption of God’s qualities comes after arrival, annihilation, and realization in abiding; this is steadiness at spiritual establishment without fluctuation.
rows.anchor: فإن التخلق بأخلاقه كان بعد الوصول والفناء والتحقق به حال البقاء وهو الاستقامة وقت التمكين وانتفاء التلوين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He looked at outward status, esteemed wealthy leaders, and turned from the poor man, hoping the leaders might strengthen Islam if they believed and slighting the poor man’s faith.
rows.anchor: اعتناء بالقوم وتقوى الإسلام بهم إن آمنوا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The admonition is that a spiritual guide must not neglect a prepared, weak seeker for a wealthy, powerful person.
rows.anchor: نبه بأن مثلك لا ينبغي أن ينظر إلى ظاهر الحال فيتشاغل عن المستعد الطالب الضعيف بالغني القوي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Judgment should focus only on readiness and acceptance of faith, not outward appearances that veil the inward state.
rows.anchor: بل يجب أن يكون نظرك مقصورا على الاستعداد وقبول الإيمان فتعتبر ذلك دون غيره ولا تحتجب بالظاهر عن الباطن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The overlooked poor man may purify and adorn himself until reaching perfection and becoming a guide to others.
rows.anchor: عسى أن يكون الفقير المتلهى عنه عاملا بالتزكية والتحلية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The rich man he approached may fail to believe because he lacks readiness or is arrogant and obstinate.
rows.anchor: والغني المتصدى له لم يؤمن لعدم استعداده أو لاستكباره وعناده
